title: [Feature Request]: MessageTransform when token limit is exceeded.
body:
### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

You can either execute a transformation from the beginning of a conversation or not at all. I think it would be useful to execute a transformation (transformations at this moment refer to content reduction), when the token limit is (or is close to be) exceeded.

### Describe the solution you'd like

Give the option to call transformations when the token limit is (or is close to) exceeded.

### Additional context

Let me know if you want me to open a PR.

linked_prs.title: Min tokens in token limiter
linked_prs.body:
## Why are these changes needed?

<!-- Please give a short summary of the change and the problem this solves. -->
A `min_tokens_threshold` is added to `MessageTokenLimiter`, which gives the option to cut tokens only after the specified message limit is reached.

## Related issue number

Closes #2306.
